reports.notes: Handwritten fax sent from a realty office (header 'JUN/15/2010/TUE 05:22 PM  Century 21 All Pros  FAX No.801-756-7672'). The Political Party cell is a fast scrawl read as 'Democratic' (the -ic ending, not 'Democrat') at medium confidence. The Office Seeking line is heavy, overlapping handwriting read as 'Utah County Commission Seat B.' at medium confidence; the seat letter B is legible and agrees with index.csv. Lines 3 and 7 are drawn as an open circle - the filer's zero glyph - transcribed as 0 at medium confidence. Most cents on the summary page are superscripted ('519 48'). The Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report boxes on the summary page were all left blank by the filer.

itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-18 wave B2 utah, chunk r2_01)

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (519.48) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (519.48) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (519.48), and is restated at summary line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' and line 5 'Subtotal'
contributions.detail: 2 Schedule A rows sum to 516.00 + 3.48 = 519.48 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the same 519.48 and is NOT summed as an increment — this is the filer's FIRST report of the cycle (line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is a handwritten zero glyph), so period and year-to-date coincide. The balance ladder closes on the same figures: 0 (line 3) + 519.48 (line 4) = 519.48 (line 5); 519.48 - 519.48 (line 6) = the printed line 7 close, a zero glyph.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (519.48) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (519.48) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (519.48), and restated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row is 519.48 and equals the schedule's printed page subtotal, its printed total, and the cover's Column A. Column B YTD prints the same 519.48 (first report of the cycle) and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. NOTE the coincidence is real and not a transcription slip: the county filing fee of 519.48 is the whole of both sides, funded by a 516.00 party contribution plus 3.48 of the candidate's own money — the same 519.48 filing fee appears on other Utah County 2010 filings in this wave.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither Schedule A nor Schedule B on this legacy_colAB blank prints an in-kind column, no row is annotated in-kind, and the p2 Summary Page carries no separate in-kind line. BOTH conventions were tested rather than inherited: monetary-only gives 519.48 on each side and monetary-plus-in-kind gives the identical 519.48 (there is no in-kind amount to add), so both close on Column A.
itemized.escalation_note: No arithmetic escalation was needed — both sides closed on three independent printed figures each (page subtotal, schedule total, Column A). Five tight crops at 900 dpi were geometry proofs and are described in the measure_notes.

Page-face Office Seeking reads 'Utah County Commission Seat B.' — with the filer's own trailing full stop — agreeing with index.csv. legacy_colAB, 4 pages, all four read full-page at 200 dpi: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election' ticked, 'No' ticked on the amendment question, signed 6.15.2010, stamped received JUN 15 PM 4:55), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by CONTENT, not ordinal), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. THE WHOLE FILING IS A FAX: every page carries the transmission header 'JUN/15/2010/TUE 05:22 PM  Century 21 All Pros  FAX No.801-756-7672  P.00n' printed across the top by the sending machine — a realty office's fax, i.e. the filer's workplace, not a county artifact. That header is the ONLY thing above the form on each sheet and it does not disturb the grid. The page-number/last-name/date-of-report box at the top right of pp2-4 is printed but LEFT WHOLLY BLANK by the filer on all three sheets (companion to the ADDENDUM A4 foliation finding: here there is no foliation at all). Lines 3 and 7 of the balance ladder are handwritten ZERO GLYPHS (open circles) and were read 0 by the 2026-08-01 cover tranche under the repo's zero-glyph ruling; this transcription does not disturb that reading. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this era in the clear, so the donor street line and PO box are plainly visible on p3 and were reduced to city/state at READ TIME; neither reaches any field or note.
